title: Cuntz comparison and Jiang–Su absorption
summary: We prove that strict comparison in the extended-functional sense implies Jiang–Su absorption for separable simple nuclear non-elementary C ∗ -algebras. This resolves the corresponding implication of the Toms–Winter regularity problem, including nonunital algebras and allowing unbounded traces. More generally, every separable nuclear C ∗ -algebra whose Cuntz semigroup is almost unperforated and fully almost divisible absorbs the Jiang–Su algebra.
family_title: Cuntz comparison, nuclear dimension, and equivariant Jiang–Su stability

review.reason: Proves strict comparison implies Jiang–Su absorption for separable simple nuclear C*-algebras.
